summary: Iteration 24: tested DELETE /api/exams/{id}/sessions, DELETE /api/sessions/{id}, and the new PDF/Word export pagination logic. Backend pytest (3/3 PASSED). Frontend Playwright flow (login → Results → export all PDF → open submitted copy → individual PDF+Word → delete-session dialog → clear-sessions dialog with SUPPRIMER confirmation + active warning) all PASSED. Multi-page PDF (long essay ~1500 words) produced 4 pages, confirming pagination works.
critical_code_review_comments: exportUtils.js exportPdf relies on html2canvas → rendered PDF is image-based, text not selectable/searchable. OK per spec (uses pagebreak css+legacy and data-avoid-break), but note: pdfplumber/pypdf can't extract student name text from PDF (expected, not a bug).

DeleteSessions.jsx: trimming+uppercase comparison for SUPPRIMER (case-insensitive accepted); spec says 'il faut taper SUPPRIMER' — current impl accepts 'supprimer' too. Minor UX, probably intentional.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_iter24_* exams with 3 student joins + long essay submission; cleaned up after tests (sessions cleared + exam deleted).
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter24 covers delete-sessions + PDF/Word export pagination. All green. For future testing, note that PDF produced by html2pdf is image-based (html2canvas), so page-count checks via pypdf work but text extraction returns empty.
